title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-M DODO Perpetual Contract With Up to 20x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch the USDⓈ-M DODO perpetual contract at  2023-08-08 12:00 (UTC) ,   with up to 20x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M DODO Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract DODOXUSDT Launch Time  2023-08-08 12:00 (UTC)  Underlying Asset DODO Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate Clamp (Funding Rate, -0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio, 0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio) Max Leverage 20x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please note:  While the underlying asset of the USDⓈ-M DODO Perpetual Contract is DODO, please note that the ticker of this USDⓈ-M DODO Perpetual Contract is “ DODOXUSDT ”.  Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the DODOXUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the DODOXUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the DODOXUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The DODOXUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
